F-r30z (Stams, Frg. 101): source-assisted reading. Lines below were reread on the image by research readers after the source was identified. Reread: 101-10v (all lines), 101-5r (lines 1-27), canvas 0 row 2 piece 4 (list), canvas 1 row 1 piece 2 and row 2 piece 5 (lists), 101-4r, 101-4v and canvas 0 row 1 piece 1 (letter phrases only), 101-10r (lines 1-26), 101-5v (lines 1-14). Other pieces rest on the unverified image-only first reading. Expansions in parentheses; [ ] lost or supplied; (?) uncertain. Canvas 0 = Stams_STA_Frg_101_01r20r, canvas 1 = Stams_STA_Frg_101_01v20v; boxes are native pixels of the 7360 x 4912 images.

== 101-10r, canvas 0, row 2 piece 5, box 4940,1760-5990,3520 (Legenda aurea c. 168)
2-5   [...] dixit [...] quid acture essetis si dyabol(us) [...] alta(?) voce [...] [ex]clamauit(?)
5-8   (red) [...] accedit [...] si aliq(uid) in eis [...] (red) [...] in beata elysabeth nichil [...]   [gloss, readings uncertain]
9-11  (red) [Deinde] dixit (red) [ecce] appropinquat media nox in qua xp(istu)s nasci voluit et in presepio requieuit.
11-14 [...] appropinquante hora sui transitus [...] tempus [...] in quo [...] deus [...] qui [...] sunt ad celestes nuptias inui[tat?]
15-16 [ad] extremam horam veniens dormiuit in pace.
16-18 Licet(?) autem eius venerabile corpus inhumatum quatuor diebus iacuisset(?) [...] ex illo [...] fetor [...]
19    [...] suauitate odoris fragrabant(?).
20-24 [Tunc] visi(?) [...] super cacumen ecclesie congregate quas nunquam aliquis prius viderat que(?) tam suaui modulacione cantabant [...] eo q(uod) eius exequias agere viderentur.
24-26 Illas autem [...] fuisse angelos qui [...] missi fuer(un)t ut eius animam in celum deferrent [...]

== 101-10v, canvas 1, row 2 piece 7, box 4860,1760-5930,3480 (Legenda aurea c. 169)
1     [...]dit et cecilie [...]
2-5   ualerian(us) p(er)rexit et s(an)c(tu)m urbanu(m) ep(iscopu)m i(n)uenit. Cu(m)q(ue) ei o(mn)ia v(er)ba cecilie dixisset, vrbanus(?) ep(iscopu)s gr(ati)as deo egit.
5-8   Tunc ualerian(us) a s(an)c(t)o urbano baptisma suscepit et rediens ceciliam cu(m) angelo loque(n)tem i(n)uenit i(n) cubiculo.
8-14  Angel(us) aut(em) duas coronas ex ros(is) et liliis i(n) manu habebat et vna(m) cecilie altera(m)q(ue) valeriano tradidit d(icens): Istas coronas mun(?)do corde [...] custodite q(uia) de paradiso dei eas vobis(?) attuli
15-18 [...] [nun]q(uam) marcescent nec odorem amittent nec ab aliis n(isi) q(ui)b(us) castitas placuerit videri poterunt.
18-20 Et tu valeriane q(ui)a utili c(on)silio c(on)sensisti(?) pete q(uod)cu(m)q(ue) volueris.
20-24 Cui valerian(us): nichil m(ihi) i(n) hac vita extitit dulci(us) q(uam) vnic(us) fr(atr)is mei affect(us). Peto ut ip(s)e mecu(m) veritate(m) agnoscat.
24-27 Cui angel(us): Placet d(omi)no petitio tua et ambo cu(m) palma martirii ad d(omi)n(u)m venietis.

== 101-5r, canvas 0, row 1 piece 5, box 4920,0-5960,1700 (Legenda aurea c. 169)
2     [...] sepe videbat angelos dei.
3-5   Valerian(us) et tiburti(us) elemosinis insistebant et [sanctor]um corpora quos almachi(us) prefect(us) occidebat ipsi sepeliebant.
5-7   Quos almachius ad se vocatos cur [pro suis] sceleribus [dampnatos] sepelirent inquisivit.
7-8   Cui tiburti(us): [ut]inam servi essemus illorum quos tu dampnatos vocas(?)   [word order uncertain]
8-9   (red) Tunc(?) [...] [ad]stare(?) valerianum(?)
14-17 [...] p(re)fect(us) dixit: ergo iupiter nomen dei non est? Cui valerian(us): nomen homicide et stupratoris est. Ad quem almachi(us): ergo totus mundus errat et tu cum fratre tuo verum deum nosti?
17-19 Valerian(us) respondit: nos soli non sumus sed innumerabilis [...]
19-22 [...] custodia maximi [...] familia crediderunt et a s(an)c(t)o urbano qui illuc venit baptism(um) susceperunt.
22-25 [...] cecilia exclamavit dicens: Eia milites xp(ist)i abicite opera tenebrarum et induimini arma lucis.

4-6   [...] Dixit eis [...] [orem]us(?) d(omi)n(u)m [...] xp(istu)m ut suis confessoribus fonte(m)(?) in hoc loco ostendat(?) [...]

10-12 et intellexit d(omi)n(u)m ih(es)um xp(istu)m esse q(uem) ip(s)e solus videbat [...] ad locum (et) d(ixit): (red) In nomine patris
13-14 filii et sp(iritu)s s(an)c(t)i in isto loco percu[tite]
